files.README.md: A small retail support agent. Policy and tool contracts are in docs/. Recorded conversations are in data/traces.json. No live runner is available.
files.docs/policy.md: Authenticate by email before accessing orders. Delivered items may be returned to their original payment method after confirmation. Policy does not specify what to do when a delivered item is subsequently lost. Shipping address must be updated before changing order items: item modification locks further edits. Do not invent facts unavailable from tools.
files.docs/tools.md: lookup_customer(email) returns customer id and order ids. get_order(id) returns status and items; no dates. Order ids are opaque; array ordering is unspecified. update_address(id,address) updates an editable order. modify_items(id,items) locks order edits. return_items(id,items,payment) requests a return.
